messages.subject: problems reordering by continuous data on y axis
parts:
Hi,
I've made a plot of some DESeq2 analyses, and it is currently being ordered by the discreet variables on the x axis (Genus names - see attached), but I want the x axis ordered by the y axis (log2FoldChange, highest to lowest). I have used the following code:

#Make ggplot2 summary of the results.
library("ggplot2")
theme_set(theme_bw())
scale_fill_discrete <- function(palname = "Set1", ...) {
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = palname, ...)
}

x <- tapply(sigtab$log2FoldChange, sigtab$Family, function(x) max(x))
x <- sort(x, TRUE)
sigtab$Family = factor(as.character(sigtab$Family), levels=names(x))

#Make plot
ggplot(sigtab, aes(x=Genus, y=log2FoldChange, color=Family)) + geom_point(size=6) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = -90, hjust = 0, vjust=0.5))

sigtab$Genus <- factor(sigtab$Genus, levels=sigtab[order(sigtab$log2FoldChange,decreasing=T),]$Genus)
ggplot(df)+geom_point(aes(x=x,y=Species),size=3,color="red")

Can you help please?
Many thanks
